notes: ABox contraction of the premise of a derived revision, paired with physics-replace-0015 (which edits "The electron was discovered in Germany"): removes "The electron was discovered by J. J. Thomson" (has_discoverer, functional). Cardinality question: was the electron discovered by Niels Bohr (no before). The one related question asks which particle was discovered at the Cavendish Laboratory in 1897 (a stored fact about the laboratory, reached through the removed fact and the bridge that Thomson worked there; the inverse reading, which particle Thomson discovered, is the same knowledge and is not used). An ideal contraction gives up the supporting knowledge too, so "I don't know" stands. 1897 keeps the answer to the electron, since the neutron was found there in 1932. Derived: the country where the discoverer worked and the year the discoverer won the Nobel Prize in Physics (both composition: the discoverer is reached by description and a stored fact about Thomson by name is looked up). The revision's country-of-discovery questions are not reused, since they rest on the derived edit. Counts are exact-phrase counts in Dolma (v4_dolma-v1_7_llama).
